ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
var rows = java.getElements('@css:ul.chapter li');
var isPreview = java.getElements('@css:.book_more').size() > 0;
var chapters = [];
function chapterKey(row) {
    return String(row.select('a[href]').first().attr('href')).split(/[?#]/)[0].split('/').pop();
}
if (isPreview) {
    var seen = JSON.parse(String(java.get('xswLastPageIds') || '{}'));
    for (var i = rows.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        var row = rows.get(i);
        var key = chapterKey(row);
        if (!seen[key]) {
            chapters.push(row);
            seen[key] = true;
        }
    }
} else {
    chapters = rows;
    if (!java.getElements('@css:.page a.next').size()) {
        var ids = {};
        for (var i = 0; i < rows.size(); i++) {
            ids[chapterKey(rows.get(i))] = true;
        }
        java.put('xswLastPageIds', JSON.stringify(ids));
    }
}
chapters;
</js>
